subject: Demo availability while you're on the road — split session or recording?

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@helioshealth.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo availability while you're on the road — split session or recording?

Hi Carlos,

Thanks for the interest in Redwood — excited to show what we can do for Helios Health.

I suggested next Friday, Apr 16 at 11:00am ET for a 45-minute walk-through of the platform (agenda attached). If that's tight given your roadshow, happy to either:

- Split into a 20–30 min high-level overview + a recorded deep-dive you can watch on the go, followed by a 30-min live Q&A.
- Or record the full demo and schedule a 1-hr office hours session when you're back.

Attached: proposed-agenda.pdf

Can you share what works best (short live + recording, or recording + office hours) and any time windows you have on Apr 16–20?

Best,

Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Demo availability while you're on the road — split session or recording?

Hi Soojin,

Thanks — appreciate the flexibility. I'm on the East Coast roadshow Apr 15–18: onsite customer visits in the morning and a field event each afternoon. My windows on Apr 16 are narrow (07:30–08:30 ET or after 19:00 ET). Apr 19 looks much better for a longer session.

I'm leaning toward the recording + a live office hours on Apr 19 so I can watch the deep-dive while in transit and then join a focused Q&A. Also, quick heads-up — please include a 10–15min section on data handling and retention; our security team will want to review that first.

Attached: roadshow-itinerary.pdf

—Carlos
Sr Product Ops
Helios Health

Hi Carlos — that plan makes sense.

Option A (if you'd like a short live touchpoint):
- Apr 16 07:30–08:00 ET — 30-min high-level overview (we'll cover business outcomes and live Q&A)

Option B (recommended given travel):
- We'll record a 35–40 minute deep-dive (security + performance + routing + cost controls) and share the recording by EOD Apr 15.
- Live office hours: Apr 19 10:00–11:00 ET for an interactive Q&A (we'll have an SRE available to answer security/data-retention questions).

I added Stephanie (Customer Success) to coordinate the office hours and Priyom (Solutions Engineering) who will record the demo and include a 15-min security segment. We'll also drop a calendar poll (slot-poll.ics) to confirm the office hours time.

If Apr 19 10:00 ET works, I'll send a calendar invite and the recording link.

Thanks — talk soon.

Soojin Lee
